_about: Hand-kept credits for what package-lock.json can't see: prebuilt native libraries (modules/*/scripts/fetch-ios-libs.sh, modules/*/android/build.gradle, pods and Maven artifacts pulled by npm packages) and bundled data. Keep versions in step with those files, then run `node scripts/licenses.mjs`. `text` is a path relative to this folder (../../LICENSE is the app's own GPL-3.0); null means there is no text to reproduce and `url` says where the terms are.
